### New

- **Chat appearance** (drawer → Chat appearance). Choose the message text size (10–22 px), the bubble corners (square to fully round) and an accent color: 8 presets or any custom color, kept readable in light and dark. A live preview sits on top, and Reset to defaults puts everything back. Sender names, quotes, forward labels and reactions scale with the text size.
- **Hyphenation for English and Russian** in message bubbles. Each message is tagged with its language so long words break cleanly on narrow screens. Links, e-mail addresses, hashtags and code are never hyphenated. You can turn it off in Chat appearance.
- **Export settings** (drawer → Export settings to Saved Messages) sends your UI settings as one readable text message to your own Saved Messages. On another device, tap **Apply these settings** on that message, check the list of changes and confirm. Relays, push, proxy/tunnel, keys, addresses, multi-device and device info are never included.
- **Push notifications settings (Android).** A new section shows the push state and lets you pick the UnifiedPush distributor or turn push off. It also shows whether your relays support push and when the last push arrived.
- **About → Show device info**: screen, viewport, scale, locale and version details for bug reports, with Copy and Share.

### Fixes

- **Narrow phones and the interface scale.** At "Large" scale, or on 320–360 px screens, full-screen windows (About, chat info, relays, profile, QR) no longer overflow or get cut off on the right. File, app, voice and call cards fit inside bubbles, and long key/value rows wrap.
- **Phone windows opened from the chat list keep the bottom bar visible again.** A short-lived full-screen change was reverted.
- **Multi-device is clearer.** If its state can't be read, it shows "unknown" and retries instead of a false "off". Turning it off asks first and explains that this device then deletes messages from the relay after download. When the core turns it back on by itself (after a backup export, adding a second device or a sync message), Velta shows a note with **Turn off again**.
- **Auto-download limit** now explains that larger files stay on the relay until you download them.
- **Reactions** under messages now follow the message text size and still wrap on small screens.
